app.name: PR Review
app.filterPulls: Filter by title, number, or branch…
app.checkoutPullUnknown: Couldn't look up a PR for {branch}, so showing its commits. {error}
app.emptyDiff: This PR has no changed files.
app.fileFiltersDescription: Files matching an enabled filter start collapsed in reviews of this repository. One gitignore-style pattern per line: tests/ hides every directory named tests, *.test.ts every such file, /docs/ only the top-level directory, and !*.snap.test.ts keeps files an earlier file pattern would hide.
app.filterMatches: {count, plural, one {# file here} other {# files here}}
app.filterIncomplete: Every filter needs a name and at least one pattern.
app.askPlaceholder: Ask the agent about these lines…
app.explainQuestion: Explain this code: why is it here, and what should I check?
app.agentThreadsDescription: T3 Code threads working in this checkout, most recently active first
app.noAgentThread: No T3 Code thread works in this checkout.
app.uncoveredWhy: Hunks the map does not place in any chapter.
app.staleHunks: {count, plural, one {# hunk named by the map is} other {# hunks named by the map are}} not in this diff, or named twice: {hunks}
app.noMap: No review map yet. gM asks the agent thread to write one.
app.newReplies: {count, plural, one {# new reply} other {# new replies}}
app.partialFileContext: This chapter shows only part of this file, so its unchanged lines stay hidden. o shows the whole file.
app.binary: Binary file or metadata-only change. No text diff is available.
app.newDraftBlocked: Save or discard your current draft before starting another comment.
app.crossSide: Select lines on the same side of the diff.
app.selectionRequired: Select a line or range first.
app.headUncommitted: head {hash} + {count, plural, one {# uncommitted file} other {# uncommitted files}}
app.draftStorageError: Browser draft storage is unavailable. Save your comment before switching PRs.
app.reviewError: The diff could not be rendered. Try reopening the PR.
app.githubDeleted: Deleted on GitHub; local copy retained
app.githubReviewDescription: Local comments stay private. Queued GitHub comments are published when you submit a review. Replies and resolutions on published threads sync immediately.
app.githubHeadChanged: The PR head differs from this snapshot. Refresh the diff and check your drafts before submitting.
app.githubUncertain: A submission has not been confirmed. Sync again to check whether GitHub received it. Its content is saved locally.
app.githubConfirmRetry: Have you checked GitHub and confirmed that the previous submission was NOT published? Allowing another attempt could otherwise create duplicates.
app.githubAllowRetry: I checked GitHub; allow another attempt
app.githubDraftCount: {count, plural, one {# comment queued for GitHub} other {# comments queued for GitHub}}
app.replySyncsGitHub: This reply will be posted on GitHub and saved locally.
app.githubEditConflict: This comment changed on GitHub while you were editing. Current GitHub version:
app.githubKeepEdit: Keep my edit for the next save
app.submitBeforeReply: Submit the review before replying on GitHub.
app.homeAgentsNote: branches whose T3 thread works in a checkout
app.homeBranchesNote: Enter opens the whole branch; commits are a scope inside it
app.homeHelp: t/n move · Enter open · g n changes since you looked · / filter · o order · r refresh · Esc back to the open review
app.commitsAhead: {count, plural, one {# commit ahead of main} other {# commits ahead of main}}
app.newRepliesIn: {count, plural, one {# new reply} other {# new replies}} in {where}
app.checkoutDetached: This checkout has no branch checked out (detached HEAD).

agent.newReplies: {count, plural, one {# new reply} other {# new replies}}

panel.sent: Sent · waiting for the thread to pick it up
panel.noThread: No thread to ask; gA lists the threads of this checkout

app.mapJobFiles: {count, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} · map-diff.patch
app.inboxEmpty: No questions yet. <key>a</key> asks about the cursor line or selection, <key>A</key> asks “Explain this code” without typing, <key>c</key> leaves a review comment. Answers show up here and as a marker next to the lines.
app.commitsCount: {count, plural, one {# commit} other {# commits}} on this branch

mapCard.asked: Asked {title} {time} ago. You can read files meanwhile; nothing moves when it lands.
mapCard.sent: Diff sent ({files, plural, one {# file} other {# files}})

mapCard.outdated: Map is for an older version
mapCard.outdatedFor: Map is for {hash}, an older version

mapCard.update: asks the agent thread to update it

app.uncoveredInCommit: {count, plural, one {# hunk} other {# hunks}} uncovered in this commit
app.searchRepoHint: * searches the word under the cursor at the head.
app.wholeFileChanged: whole file at {hash}, this review's changes marked
app.wholeFileHead: whole file at {hash}, not changed in this review
app.commentInWholeFile: Comment from the diff: Esc returns to it.

changes.title: Changes since you looked
changes.noTurns: This thread has no turns yet.
changes.unfinished: No turn since turn {turn} has finished with a snapshot yet; its changes show once one has.
changes.excluded: What merges and rebases brought in from other branches is left out; conflict resolutions show.

app.homeNewTurns: {count, plural, one {# turn} other {# turns}} since you looked
app.openQuestions: {count, plural, one {# open question} other {# open questions}}
app.hunksInChapter: {count, plural, one {# hunk in this chapter} other {# hunks in this chapter}}
app.unresolvedComments: {count, plural, one {# unresolved comment} other {# unresolved comments}}
app.badNotes: {count, plural, one {# note names lines} other {# notes name lines}} this diff does not show: {notes}
